researchNotes:
LICENSING: not checked against data/licensed-institutions.json (file did not exist when research started; verify with npm run validate-data). licensedInstitutionId 'home-credit' set as instructed. Legal name on the company's own contract and footer: Công ty Tài chính TNHH Một thành viên Home Credit Việt Nam, MST 0307672788, Ho Chi Minh City.
OWNERSHIP/RENAME: no rename found; site footer and the Ver05.2026 contract use the same name. Secondary news (search snippets, dates unreliable, low confidence): Home Credit Group agreed to sell 100% of the Vietnam unit to SCB/SCBX of Thailand for over EUR 800 million, and the Group later confirmed (reported as March 2026) the deal could not be completed. Not verified at an official source.
MAJOR CONTRADICTION (cash loan rate): the product page advertises 'từ 0,75%/tháng (dư nợ giảm dần)' = 9%/year. The company's rate-disclosure sheet effective 21/07/2026 says new customers pay 45%-55%/year reducing balance (existing customers 16.22%-49.50%). The 0.75% headline is far below the official new-customer minimum; the official sheet is used and 0.75% kept only as a low-confidence example. The cost engine should not use 0.75%/month for a first-time borrower.
REDUCING vs FLAT: cash loan is reducing balance (sheet and page agree). Motorbike homepage says flat 0.55%/month. Electronics and motorbike product pages state no basis.
CONTRACT TEMPLATE (cash loan, Ver05.2026, effective 22/05/2026; scanned images read visually, pages 1-3 and 5 of 8 only): rate, early-repayment % and overdue-interest % are blank per customer; overdue principal interest = 150% of in-term rate; early repayment needs lender consent, a minimum number of paid instalments, 1 day notice, and the early-repayment fee as % of outstanding principal; insurance premium can be financed inside the loan principal and paid directly to the insurer; borrower pays third-party transfer or cash-withdrawal fees; cash loan contract cannot be cancelled after disbursement. Pages 4, 6-8 not read, so any late fee or collection fee there is unknown.
INSURANCE: optional Gói An tâm Tài chính is offered at loan registration (FAQ); the rate sheet lists a separate loan 'cho vay để thanh toán phí bảo hiểm' at 16.22%-55%/year reducing, so premiums can be financed. Whether any loan makes insurance mandatory, the premium for the package, and deducted-vs-added treatment are not stated publicly (hotline 1900 633 633). Insurance timing 'added_to_loan' is inferred from the contract structure, not stated for a specific product.
GAPS: late fee amounts, early repayment %, collection-point fees (FAQ lists collection points, no fee stated), minimum income, motorbike and electronics rate basis, credit card figures, Home PayLater (homepaylater.vn, BNPL, 1-12 months, 0% promo for 1-3 months), Big Ticket and entrusted-loan contracts not collected. Online flag left null: the homepage says cash loans are online, but its application process lists visiting a branch.
CONFIDENCE: electronics, motorbike and card products are low (marketing pages, no basis, no fees).
